div.head: VI Atr 10
div.ab: K. ⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt man Christene men for ealles to lytlan to deaðe ne forræde.
⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt man Christene men for ealles to lytlan to deaðe ne forræde.
And witena gerædnes is þæt man Christene men for ealles to lytlan to deaðe ne forræde.
Und Verordnung der Witan ist, dass man christliche Menschen nicht für gar zu Geringes zum Tode verdamme.
And it is the ordinance of the witan that Christian people are not to be condemned to death for all too small [offences].
And the decree of the councillors is, that Christian men shall not be condemned to death for too trivial offences,
And the decree of the councilors is that Christians are not to be sentenced to death for entirely too little.

note.seg: Dies und 10, 2 benutzt II Cn 2, 1 = Leis Wl 40. In forrædan seh ich nur bedeutungslose Abweichung von fordeman in V Atr, nicht (mit Patetta Lex Frision. in Mem. accad. Torino Ser. 2 t. 43, 29) ‘exponere, zur Tötung Gelegenheit geben’

This and 10, 2 are used by II Cn 2, 1 = Leis Wl 40. In forrædan I see only an insignificant variation on fordeman in V Atr, not (with Patetta Lex Frision. in Mem. accad. Torino Ser. 2 t. 43, 29) ‘exponere, to give occasion for killing’
